title: Onye Mbụ Ịchọ Mgbaghara
intro: Laghachi azụ n'oge tupu anyanwụ apụta, tupu mmadụ ọ bụla ejee ije n'ụwa. E ji ihe ndị kacha dị ala kpụọ otu ihe, nye ya ebe dị elu karịa ndị mmụọ ozi, ma tinye ya n'ogige dị nsọ na ịdọ aka ná ntị doro anya. Ma n'otu oge, e mere nhọrọ - nke ga-ada ụda n'akụkọ ihe mere eme mmadụ niile. Ònye bụ onye a?
clues: E kere m n'ụzọ dị iche na nke ọ bụla ọzọ — e ji ájá ala kpụọ m ma nye m mkpụrụ obi dị ndụ site n'aka Onye Okike.
E nyere m ihe ọmụma miri emi nke na ọbụna ndị mmụọ ozi nọ n'elu tụrụ m n'anya.
E nyere eluigwe nile iwu ka ha kpọọ isiala n'ihu m, ha nile wee doo onwe ha n'okpuru - ma e wezụga otu onye, ​​onye jụrụ n'ihi mpako.
E tinyere m n'ogige dị nsọ, ebe nkasi obi na ihe oriri na-adịgide adịgide — mana e nwere otu iwu siri ike.
Echefuru m, m mịpụrụ, m nupụkwara isi — enwekwara m mmetụta nke ibu arọ nke mmejọ m nke ukwuu.
M tụgharịrị gaa n'ebe Onyenwe m nọ site n'okwu sitere n'obi, O wee nabata nchegharị m, n'ihi na Ọ bụ Onye Kachasị Mgbaghara.

trial.label: Nnwale/Ihe Omume
options: E nyere ndị mmụọ ozi iwu ka ha kpọọ isiala
E zigara nnukwu iju mmiri ahụ
E mere ka ọkụ dị ukwuu dị jụụ ma dịkwa nchebe
E riri otu onye ọchịchị dị mpako n'oké osimiri
trial.answer: E nyere ndị mmụọ ozi iwu ka ha kpọọ isiala

outcome.label: Nsonaazụ
options: Ifufe na-ekpo ọkụ gbara ya ọkụ

arabic: فَتَلَقَّىٰٓ ءَادَمُ مِن رَّبِّهِۦ كَلِمَـٰتٍۢ فَتَابَ عَلَيْهِ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلتَّوَّابُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
verse: Then Adam received from his Lord [some] words, and He accepted his repentance. Indeed, it is He who is the Accepting of Repentance, the Merciful. (2:37)
